Aubrey Lin: Hey folks  Aubrey here, first day as a Site Reliability Engineer! (they/them) Based in SF, usually biking in. Proud owner of a very opinionated kitten named Pixel and a penchant for cold brew. Excited to meet everyone.
Carlos M.: Welcome Aubrey!! :tada: Pixel already has top-tier taste. If you bike in, there's a secure rack near the elevator and a tiny repair kit in the maker corner.
Jenna Ortiz: Hi Aubrey  I'm your onboarding buddy this week. Ping me for access gaps or repo questions. Also, weekly "ops puzzle" is Thursday mornings if you like tiny brain twisters.
onboarding-bot: Welcome @Aubrey Lin! You've been added to #new-hires and granted access to the "SRE Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/sre (automated)
Aubrey Lin: Thanks!! Quick heads-up: allergic to strawberries (so no strawberry tarts pls) and Pixel will be photobombing video calls frequently. Any recommendations for local cold brew?
Carlos M.: Cold brew rec: Steep House on Valencia does a single-origin nitro that's dangerously good. Also note: we have a "bring-your-pet" photo board in the kitchen  Pixel pics encouraged.
Facilities: Hi Aubrey! Welcome kit en route (hoodie M, sticker pack, desk plant). Please DM desk preference (standing vs seated) and we'll book. Logged allergy: strawberries.
Jenna Ortiz: Sent a 20-min intro sync for Wed 9:30am PT to walk through paging and runbook basics. Also I'll add Pixel to the photo board this Friday.
Aubrey Lin: Sending Pixel's best mugshot now  see you Wed and thanks for the warm welcome! :cat2:
